records.issue_text: lib/post_revisor.rb:85 — The return value of @post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations]) is never checked before continuing to save_reply_relationships and returning true from revise!, so a failed save is silently treated as success
records.rationale: In lib/post_revisor.rb `update_post` now calls `@post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations])` and unconditionally proceeds to `@post.save_reply_relationships` without checking whether the save succeeded. This means a failed save (possible even when validations are skipped, e.g., DB constraints/callbacks) would be silently ignored and subsequent logic would run on an unsaved/invalid state.
